program.title: CyberHeist Field Academy
program.promise: A structured beginner path with short lessons, safe simulations, recall practice, and a final defensive capstone.
program.outcome: Build and demonstrate strong cybersecurity foundations and beginner defensive workflows. Specialist expertise requires further study, supervised practice, and experience.

days.title: Read a message critically
days.objective: Pause, inspect context, and choose a trusted verification route.

days.title: Protect an account
days.objective: Choose unique credentials and add a second proof of identity.

days.title: Choose a trusted connection
days.objective: Recognize network-name uncertainty and protect sensitive activity.

days.title: Share less personal data
days.objective: Spot unnecessary data requests and select a safer privacy choice.

days.title: Keep devices current
days.objective: Understand updates and choose a safe update path.

days.title: Prepare for recovery
days.objective: Use backups and recovery options before a problem occurs.

days.title: Foundation field check
days.objective: Combine the first week's habits in a short defensive case.

days.title: How sign-in proves identity
days.objective: Separate identity claims from evidence used to verify them.

days.title: Passkeys in plain language
days.objective: Explain how passkeys reduce reliance on shared secrets.

days.title: MFA methods compared
days.objective: Choose a second factor based on the account and available options.

days.title: Account recovery safely
days.objective: Review recovery channels and protect the recovery process.

days.title: Least privilege
days.objective: Give a user or app only the access needed for its task.

days.title: Shared devices and sessions
days.objective: Find and close sessions that should no longer be active.

days.title: Identity review
days.objective: Apply access and recovery habits in a fictional account review.

days.title: A device joins a network
days.objective: Trace the basic path from a device to a service.

days.title: Addresses and names
days.objective: Distinguish an address from a human-readable domain name.

days.title: DNS as a directory
days.objective: Describe the role of name lookup without treating it as proof of trust.

days.title: What encryption protects
days.objective: Explain what an encrypted connection does and does not guarantee.

days.title: Routers and network boundaries
days.objective: Identify the purpose of a home router and guest network.

days.title: Wi-Fi settings that matter
days.objective: Choose reasonable home Wi-Fi and guest-access settings.

days.title: Connection path review
days.objective: Read a fictional network diagram and identify safer choices.

modules.title: Devices & operating systems
modules.subtitle: The everyday systems you rely on

days.title: Files and sensitive information
days.objective: Classify common files and choose appropriate handling.

days.title: Apps and permissions
days.objective: Match permissions to an app's real purpose.

days.title: Updates and support windows
days.objective: Recognize when software is no longer receiving fixes.

days.title: Browser safety controls
days.objective: Use browser settings and site indicators with good judgment.

days.title: Backups and restore checks
days.objective: Plan a backup routine and confirm that recovery is possible.

days.title: Device loss response
days.objective: Prioritize account protection and device recovery steps.

days.title: Personal device review
days.objective: Review a fictional device setup for practical improvements.

days.title: Pressure and persuasion
days.objective: Notice urgency, authority, and secrecy as decision-pressure cues.

days.title: Verify a request out of band
days.objective: Confirm unusual requests through a separate trusted channel.

days.title: Personal data and consent
days.objective: Minimize collection and explain a reasonable data choice.

days.title: Safe sharing and permissions
days.objective: Check recipients and access before sharing a file.

days.title: Report a concern
days.objective: Choose a useful reporting route and include relevant facts.

days.title: Keep useful evidence
days.objective: Preserve a clear timeline without spreading sensitive material.

days.title: Trust and privacy case
days.objective: Resolve a fictional privacy concern with a measured response.

days.title: What an event log records
days.objective: Read timestamps, actors, actions, and outcomes in sample events.

days.title: Normal activity and context
days.objective: Use a baseline and context before deciding an event is unusual.

days.title: Sign-in alerts
days.objective: Prioritize a sign-in alert using time, location context, and user report.

days.title: Signal, noise, and confidence
days.objective: Record evidence and uncertainty separately.

days.title: Triage a small queue
days.objective: Rank fictional alerts by impact and urgency.

days.title: Write a useful incident note
days.objective: Summarize observable facts, actions, and next owner.

days.title: Monitoring desk exercise
days.objective: Triage a static, fictional event timeline.

modules.title: Build & configure carefully
modules.subtitle: Defensive design for apps and cloud services

days.title: Security goals for a feature
days.objective: Name the data, people, and failure outcomes a feature should protect.

days.title: Validate input as data
days.objective: Explain why apps check format, length, and allowed values.

days.title: Access checks in an app
days.objective: Match each action to an explicit permission check.

days.title: Protect configuration values
days.objective: Keep private configuration out of public code and logs.

days.title: Cloud roles and storage
days.objective: Choose limited access for a fictional cloud service.

days.title: Secure defaults
days.objective: Prefer settings that protect a user before customization.

days.title: Configuration review
days.objective: Improve a fictional app and cloud configuration.

days.title: Recognize and report
days.objective: Decide when to report and whom to contact.

days.title: Prioritize impact
days.objective: Assess affected accounts, devices, and information.

days.objective: Give affected people accurate next steps without speculation.

days.title: Investigate the timeline
days.objective: Connect message, account, and event clues without assuming facts.

days.title: Choose and explain a response
days.objective: Select proportionate defensive actions and explain trade-offs.

days.title: Defender field review
days.objective: Demonstrate core habits in a reviewed, fictional tabletop case.
